mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/gherkin.test.ts:gherkin acceptance / loaded binding cleanup runs after failed outcomes and cleanup failure cannot pass
mappings.title: loaded binding cleanup runs after failed outcomes and cleanup failure cannot pass

A second steps module fail-cleanup.ts exports a no-op binding for the same step and a cleanup() function that throws Error('cleanup refusal').
when: runAcceptance(undefined, { root }) is executed so bindings are loaded from tests/acceptance/steps.ts.
runAcceptance(undefined, { root, stepsModulePath: fail-cleanup.ts }) is then executed against the alternate module.
then: The first run rejects with the original step failure message test failure.

examples: Failure path 1: step throws test failure, but cleanup still leaves a cleaned sentinel file.
Failure path 2: the scenario body succeeds, cleanup throws cleanup refusal, and the acceptance artifact remains failed.
limitations: Two concrete failure phases are exercised inside one declaration instead of separate leaf tests.
